VaultKeyRecord.title: Vault Key Record
VaultKeyRecord.description: Alphanumeric public key and encrypted vault wrap synced for a user's Key Bank.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

keyTag.description: Short label or key tag (no contact card required).

fingerprint.description: Short alphanumeric fingerprint of the public key.

publicKeyToken.description: Shareable alphanumeric ECDH public key token.

cipherMode.description: Preferred cipher mode for this key.

ownIdentity.description: True if this record represents the user's own public identity key.

UserPreferences.title: User Preferences
UserPreferences.description: Synced keyboard and security preferences for the authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

hyperEncryptionDefault.description: Whether Hyper Encryption is active by default.

numberRowVisible.description: Whether the Gboard top number row is shown.

hapticFeedbackEnabled.description: Whether keypress haptic feedback is enabled.

autoCheckUpdates.description: Whether periodic background update checks are enabled.

/users/{userId}/vault_keys/{keyId}.description: Per-user Key Bank entries stored under the owner's UID.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Per-user synced keyboard & security preferences document (settings).
